content:
The 3rd Virtual Job Fair of the Instituto Politécnico de Leiria takes place on 22 April, hosting an online exhibition area featuring BUILT CoLAB and more than 60 other companies and institutions. Together they will offer more than 600 job and internship opportunities to students at that polytechnic.


This is one of the initiatives included in the 3rd Employability Week, taking place from 19 to 23 April, in online format. The programme of activities also includes webinars and workshops on job-search techniques, curriculum vitae writing, skills development and employability, raising awareness of entrepreneurship, international internship opportunities, happiness at work, alumni testimonials and a company showcase, among others.


The event will take place here. Anyone interested in working at BUILT CoLAB can check all available vacancies here.
